chalisa.do1: Victory to Gaṇeśa, son of Girijā, root of all good, the wise one. Ayodhyādāsa says: Grant the boon of fearlessness.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to you, Lord of Girijā, compassionate to the lowly; you always protect and sustain the saints. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: The moon shines beautifully on your forehead; in your ears are earrings of serpents' hoods. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: Your body is fair, and on your head you bear the flowing Gaṅgā; you wear a garland of skulls and have smeared your body with ashes. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: For a garment, a tiger skin graces you; seeing your beauty, serpents and sages are enchanted. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: The darling daughter of Mother Mainā, Pārvatī, is at your left side, and her matchless beauty shines there. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: The trident in your hand shines with great splendour; it ever brings enemies to ruin. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: How do Nandī and Gaṇeśa look there? Like lotuses in the middle of the ocean. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: The dark-hued Kārttikeya and Gaṇeśa, king of the gaṇas: this beauty can never be put into words. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: As soon as the gods went and cried out to you, then and there, Lord, you took away their sorrow. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: Tāraka wrought great havoc; all the gods together bowed to you and pleaded. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: At once you sent the six-faced Kārttikeya, who struck him down in the twinkling of an eye. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: You slew the demon Jalandhara; your fair fame is known throughout the world. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: You waged war on Tripurāsura and in your grace saved everyone. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Bhagīratha performed great austerities, and Śiva, the foe of Tripura, fulfilled his vow. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Among givers there is none like you; your servants ever sing your praise. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: The Vedas have sung the glory of your name; you are beyond words and without beginning, and they could not find your secret. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: In the churning of the ocean a blaze arose; gods and demons were scorched and in torment. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: There you showed mercy and came to their help; then you came to be called Nīlakaṇṭha, the blue-throated. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: When Śrī Rāma worshipped you, he conquered Laṅkā and gave it to Vibhīṣaṇa. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: He had undertaken a worship with a thousand lotuses, and just then Śiva, the foe of Tripura, put him to the test. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: The Lord kept back one of the lotuses; then the lotus-eyed Śrī Rāma wished to make the worship with that lotus of his own eye in its place. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: Seeing this unflinching devotion, Lord Śiva was pleased and granted the boons he desired. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Victory, victory, victory to you, the endless, the imperishable; dwelling in the heart of all, you show grace to all. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: All the wicked torment me day after day; I go on wandering and find no peace. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: Save me, save me, I cry to you, my Lord; come at this hour and rescue me. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Take up your trident and strike down the enemies; come and rescue me from distress. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: Mother, father, brothers, everyone is there, yet in distress no one asks after me. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Master, my one hope is in you; come and take away my heavy distress. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: You always give wealth to the poor; whoever asks of you receives the fruit. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: In what way shall I praise you? Lord, forgive my failings now. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Śiva, you are the destroyer of distress, the cause of all good, the remover of obstacles. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Yogīs, ascetics and sages meditate on you; Nārada and Sarasvatī bow their heads to you. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Salutation, salutation, victory, salutation to Śiva! The gods, Brahmā and the rest, have not found his end. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Whoever recites this with his heart in it, Śiva becomes his helper. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Anyone in debt who is fit for it and recites this gains release from the debt. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: If one who has no son wishes for one, Śiva's grace surely comes upon him. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Let him call a paṇḍita on the thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight, and have the fire-offering performed with care. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Let him always keep the fast of the thirteenth day; no affliction remains in his body. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Let him offer incense, a lamp and food, and recite this before Śiva. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: He destroys the sins of birth after birth, and in the end gains a dwelling in the city of Śiva. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: Ayodhyādāsa says: My hope is in you; knowing this, take away all my sorrows. ॥41॥
chalisa.do2: Daily, as a rule, at dawn I recite the forty verses; Lord of the universe, fulfil the desire of my heart.
chalisa.do3: Know it as the sixth of Mārgaśīrṣa, in the Hemanta season, in saṃvat sixty-four: then, for blessing, this hymn of praise to Śiva, the Chālīsā, was completed.
